UULTIS /MATERIALS & PROCESS

Considered by nature.

Explore the choices that connect design, production and responsible use of resources.

Wood sourcing

Uultis prioritizes renewable wood and responsible forest management. Grupo Herval obtained FSC certification for certain products in 2019; this does not mean every item is certified.

Foams

Some formulations use soy-based biopolyol. A continuous, closed production process helps reduce material losses, water use and vapor emissions.

Packaging & supply

Bulk deliveries, packaging improvements and reuse initiatives aim to reduce discarded material.

Facilities

Rainwater reuse, natural light and ventilation, efficient lighting and thermal insulation support more efficient resource use.

Recovery & reuse

Wood residues can be reused for energy. Uultis reports participation in ASLORE since 2021 to support reverse logistics and packaging recycling.
